GET /organizations.summary: List organizations the user has access to
GET /organizations.description:
Retrieve a list of organizations a particular user has access to. At most one of
`containing.account`, `containing.user`, or `containing.organization` may be provided.

parameters.description:
Only return organizations with the specified IDs (ex. id=foo&id=bar). Send multiple elements
by repeating the query value.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description:
(case-sensitive) Filter the list of organizations to where the name is equal to a
particular string.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of organizations to where the name starts with a
particular string.
parameters.name: name.startsWith

parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of organizations to where the name ends with a particular
string.
parameters.name: name.endsWith

parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of organizations to where the name contains a particular
string.
parameters.name: name.contains

parameters.description:
Filter the list of organizations to the ones that contain this particular
account.
parameters.name: containing.account

parameters.description:
Filter the list of organizations to the ones that contain this particular
user.

IMPORTANT: Just because an organization "contains" a user is not a
representation of any authorization or privilege to manage any resources
therein. An organization "containing" a user simply means the user is managed by
that organization.
parameters.name: containing.user

parameters.description:
Filter the list of organizations to the ones that contain this particular
organization.
parameters.name: containing.organization

parameters.description:
Filter the list of organizations to the ones that are a sub-organization
of the specified organization.

"null" is a valid value to provide for this parameter. It means "where
an organization has no parent (i.e. it is a 'root' organization)."
parameters.name: parent.id
member.email
parameters.description:
Filter organizations to those where the given user, by email, is an active member of
that exact organization. This does not include hierarchy-derived access.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description:
Field to order results by. Currently supported values: `name`.
When not specified, results are ordered by hierarchy.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
Sort direction for the `order_by` field. Defaults to `asc` when `order_by` is
specified.

An opaque token returned from the last list response that when
provided will retrieve the next page.

Parameters used to filter the retrieved list must remain in subsequent
requests with a page token.
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.description: The amount of items to return. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: page_size

items.description: References an Organization in the Cloudflare data model.

hierarchy_tags.description:
Ordered chain of organization tags from the root organization down to
(and including) this organization itself. Root organizations return a
single-element array containing their own tag; sub-organizations return
`[rootTag, ...intermediateTags, parentTag, selfTag]`. Useful for
constructing authorization scopes that need to cover every ancestor
in the hierarchy.

next_page_token.description:
Use this opaque token in the next request to retrieve the
next page.

Parameters used to filter the retrieved list must remain in subsequent
requests with a page token.

total_size.description: Counts the total amount of items in a list with the applied filters. The API omits next_page_token to indicate no more items in a particular list.

attached to sub-organizations are not included. Use `page_token` and `page_size` for cursor
pagination, or provide `page` and `per_page` together for legacy offset pagination. Cursor
pagination takes precedence when requested. The default response uses Account fields;
`Accept: application/json; legacy=true` requests the LegacyAccount representation.

POST /organizations.description:
Create a new organization for a user. Sub-organization creation availability depends on
the organization's capabilities. The optional `profile` object accepts partial profile
details; its individual fields are not required. Organization names are limited to 65
UTF-8 bytes. Each profile field is limited to 1,000 UTF-8 bytes, and a non-empty business
email must be valid. At least one of business name, address, phone, or email must be
non-empty to persist a profile.

name.description: The Organization name, limited to 65 UTF-8 bytes.

profile.description: Optional profile fields, each limited to 1,000 UTF-8 bytes. An empty profile is ignored.

result.description: References an Organization in the Cloudflare data model.

Ordered chain of organization tags from the root organization down to

single-element array containing their own tag; sub-organizations return
`[rootTag, ...intermediateTags, parentTag, selfTag]`. Useful for
constructing authorization scopes that need to cover every ancestor
in the hierarchy.

PUT /organizations/{organization_id}/inv.description:
Accept or reject an invitation to a specific organization.

The credential must belong to the invited user. No additional API token permission is
required.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: The ID of the organization associated with the invitation.

parameters.name: member_code
parameters.description: The invitation code to accept or reject.

requestBody.description: The invitation action. Use `accept` to join the organization or `reject` to decline the invitation.

result.description:
Membership returned after handling an Organization invitation. Invite handling populates
user ID and email; name, two-factor status, and timestamps contain placeholder values.

Partially updates the business profile (name, email, phone, address, and external metadata)
associated with this organization's customer record, creating the profile if it does not
exist. Changes apply to every account and organization sharing that profile. Omitted,
empty, or null fields are left unchanged. Each profile field is limited to 1,000 UTF-8
bytes. Only available to members of the organization.
